images.caption: A small blue character piece with a stylized face is worked into a patch of white lettering along the lower side of a dark TCIx tank car lettered 250837. The car sits on the near track with a second tank car passing on the far track behind the trees.
A bold red and white letter piece covers the lower half of a TTX intermodal well car, standing out against the yellow body. A black UTLX tank car follows closely behind on the right.

A multi-color wildstyle piece in blue, white, and green fills the lower left panel of a TTX intermodal well car, with a matching purple and blue throw-up on the right. The car is lettered TTX 675480 and bears a red and blue 'X' logo. The scene is a tree-lined trackside against a hazy lake on an overcast day.

The cream-and-yellow food-themed pictorial piece fills the lower panel of a maroon BNSF boxcar, 485643, the BNSF logo still clean above it. The car sits centered against a grey river and forested far shore, a lone tree to its right.

A white and green wildstyle piece with a circular emblem and flowing linework covers the side of a BNSF hopper (473456), the white block standing out against the maroon car. The pass runs along a lake with a forested far shore.
A tan boxcar displays the same painted gray angular shape with hatched lines and a blue block, a modest pictorial piece on a plain panel.

A white hopper car carries a large, detailed mural featuring dark, stylized characters or figures across its entire side. The piece is a complex, composed work that stands out against the natural background.

A colorful, multi-letter piece, possibly reading 'BUBA', is painted on the lower side of a BNSF boxcar, number 495257, in a mix of blue, orange, and white. The car is positioned centrally, with the clean boxcar from the previous frame now on its right.

A BNSF boxcar 470266 carries a long, multi-color piece of interlocked letters across its mid-panel, with a small character or emblem worked into the design on the right side. The piece is dense and colorful, a real effort on the maroon livery.
A dark hopper car painted with a multi-element piece of white and grey lettering plus small character shapes and a circular logo, moving past a plain white car on the right.
The green wildstyle piece is now centered on the hopper, with a blue tag beneath the BNSF lettering.

A dark boxcar carries a long, low-lying run of light-colored wildstyle lettering across its lower panel, the piece mostly lost in shadow against the bright river. The car sits in a tree-lined cut beside the water.

A vibrant multi-color piece reading 'U BETTER CHILL' in bubble letters with a rainbow fill and black drop shadows covers the lower half of a white GATX boxcar. The piece is composed and playful, standing out against the plain white panel.

A white CEFX hopper car featuring a low, multi-colored piece along its lower panel, including a row of green bubble letters and a small character with a crown. The paint is modest but adds a splash of color to the otherwise plain car.

A multi-color piece with white and blue letters and a small character in the center is painted low on a dark red BNSF hopper, number 477950. The piece is a standard throw-up style with some imagery worked into the letters.

A large pictorial piece in teal and purple with geometric, architectural imagery dominates the side of a well car, a composed mural-scale work. A yellow TBOX intermodal well car with a red logo is on the right.

The teal-and-purple pictorial mural on the well car is now centered, its blocky architectural shapes and shading clearly readable. A yellow TBOX intermodal well car with white graffiti sits to the right.

A full row of white, round-headed cartoon characters with simple faces is painted along the bottom of a yellow auto-rack, creating a playful mural-like effect. The car is moving right-to-left, with another yellow unit visible at the right edge.

A large, hand-painted pink and purple character piece dominates the side of a BNSF hopper, featuring flowing linework and a prominent circular white logo at the center. The car is lettered BNSF 475840 and moves past a misty river crossing.
A multi-color piece on a maroon BNSF boxcar 476853 mixes wildstyle lettering with purple and green character work and flame accents, a composed piece well worth a look.

The yellow 'ARCO' throw-up with its blue-and-white character face sits fully in frame on the maroon BNSF 472399 boxcar, the face and lettering crisp against the dark red. A multi-color piece is visible on the car to the right.

A full-length, multi-color mural runs along the bottom of this orange-framed louvered auto-rack: bold lettering in pink, blue and yellow, a large dark 'M', and a circular sun-like character with a figure, all worked into a composed, picture-first piece. It is an orange auto-carrier passing a lake.

A composed character piece in green with a Santa-hat figure and a small brown character is painted across the lower panel of a cream BNSF boxcar reporting 314499. It is a deliberate, picture-first work rather than plain lettering.

A BNSF hopper 497429 features a striking piece with a realistic, black-and-white portrait of a face wearing a hood, integrated with green and white lettering. The character work is detailed and stands out as a focal point of the pass.
A detailed anime-style character with silver hair and a yellow outfit is painted on the side of a maroon BNSF hopper, 491947. The piece stands out against the dark red paint of the car.

The green boxcar is fully in frame, showing a composed piece: white stencil text across the top, a large white 'N' logo, and a blue and white wildstyle lettering run with character work along the bottom. A grey boxcar follows at the right edge.
A multi-color wildstyle piece in pink, green, and blue with character work sits low along the panel of a maroon BNSF boxcar 492170, with the big white BNSF logo still reading above it.

A full pictorial mural of stylized orange and blue fish runs the length of the lower panels, an intentional picture-first piece on a white TTX auto-carrier, reporting marks 300084, with a yellow throw-up at the left end.
A composed piece featuring yellow lettering and a central character with a red face and blue outline sits on the side of a BNSF boxcar. The car is identified as BNSF 498156.

A low, sprawling multi-color piece of pastel and pink figures sits along the lower panel of a maroon COER 321078 boxcar, while a large white block-letter piece dominates the adjacent BNSF car to the right. The train runs past a calm, tree-lined water body under a flat overcast sky.
